rules.alternatives: Ongoing ABMS or AOA-BOS recertification/MOC instead of hours (lifetime certification alone does not count). Military training substantially equivalent may count. Emeritus status: 15 hours per year.
rules.new_licensee_rule: 30 hours if licensed during the second year of the biennium; pain management course at initial licensure. Residents in training are exempt.
rules.audit_note: Board may audit; 60 days to provide certificates. Deficient: $250 fine and 120 days to comply ($1,000 after 120 days, suspension of at least 90 days after 180 days). Cultural competency audited every other renewal cycle.

topics.who: All licensees except lapsed, teleradiology and telemonitoring: Oregon Pain Management Commission one-hour course, at initial licensure and every 24 months (OAR 847-008-0075)
All practicing licensees except residents and Volunteer Camp: at least 1 hour per year (OHA-approved or qualifying experiences), reported every other renewal (OAR 847-008-0077)

rules.notes: One board licenses MDs and DOs. Renewal due Dec 31 of odd-numbered years (OAR 847-008-0005). The board's CE page states this as 30 hours/year. Level II office-based surgery without board certification: 50 h CME/year. Suicide-risk and Alzheimer's CME count as relevant.
rules.rule_quote: …(b) 60 hours of continuing medical education (CME) per two years relevant to the licensee’s current medical practice,…
rules.accepted_credit_types: AMA PRA Category 1; AOA Category 1-A or 2-A (relevant to current practice). Emeritus: AMA Cat 1 or 2, AOA 1-A/1-B/2-A/2-B
